notes.title: NEW UPDATE#21!
notes.content:
INFINITY DRIFT
New track location in the world of Japan.
The track is in a construction zone! Two high jumps! Transfer in a flight!

COUNTRY ROAD
New track location in the world of America.
Variations in terrain elevations and track slopes. The track is in hilly areas and along the streets of a cottage village.

2.5K OBJECTS in Constructor
The number of objects in Track Constructor Mode has been increased from 1000 to 2500!

POINTS RESET DISABLED
Disabled reset of points when hitting the road and concrete.
Jump more and have no problems.

SOUND OF OTHER PLAYERS' CARS
The sound volume of other players' cars has been reduced.
In tandem mode when driving as a leader the sound of the chaser's engine will no longer disturb you.

Many optimizations & small improvements

notes.title: ANNIVERSARY UPDATE#20: Two years of OverDrift!
notes.content:
Exactly two years have passed since the release of our project. During this time, the project has changed a lot.
New cars, new wheels, new worlds and locations have been added. New content and new gaming features have been added.
Lots and lots of things.
Our development team thanks the players for their support of the project, for your proposed ideas,
for your active participation in development!
We continue to work on the project!

TURBO KITS
5 turbo kits!
Select and install any of the 5 turbo kits available in the store according to your wishes.
Different sounds of the turbine and blow off.

TRACK CONSTRUCTOR UPDATE
New objects added:
- Trucks
- Construction Machines
- Balloons & Airplane
- National Japanese buildings
- Amusement attrations
- Road Blocks
- Tankers
- Miscellaneous
Now you can create your own game worlds!

Many optimizations, small improvements and many bugs fixed

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JUAbXzqJdP0;full][/previewyoutube]
TRACK CONSTRUCTOR
Huge space for creativity!
Create your own tracks in a special game mode. Test and edit. Create public servers for all players or ride with friends in your own drift world!

Select a location - three islands of your choice.
Build a track from a set of road elements. Customize the road to your liking.
Choose any season and time of day to suit your taste.

Create a server with your track or join servers with other players' tracks. You can save any track you like to your Track Collection. You can then edit the track to improve it.

The track constructor is still under development, many features will be added in the future.
We are waiting for your feedback and suggestions for development.

3 NEW CARS added to OVERPASS
* 2012 3F COUPE
* 1999 DX-7 R
* 2015 6F COUPE

notes.title: BIG UPDATE#17!
notes.content:
HAPPY NEW YEAR & MERRY CHRISTMAS!

LIVERY SHARING
Added a system for distributing liveries from player to player.
If You want to distribute You can mark the livery you want to give away in Livery Workshop > Share The Livery Of This Car.
You can buy liveries of other players in Main Menu > Sharing Livery.
Just make sure that you currently have the same car selected for which the purchased livery is made.
The livery store bank is accumulated for each player individually - liveries are added when meeting a dealer player in the game world.
When changing game server or restart the game all accumulated liveries in the bank are retained.

5 NEW CARS added to OVERPASS
* 2013 STRONGER
* 2000 SH2000
* 1999 DX-7 TS
* 2005 REVO
* 1990 XAEDO
//The OverPass level will be reset to 10 to unlock newly added cars

CUSTOM CAR SOUND SIGNAL for OVERPASS owners
You can choose the sound you like in Main Menu > Customization > Horn

GRAPHICS IMPROVEMENTS
* Completely new materials on most objects in the game world
* Dirty materials

CARS
* Completely redesigned stance fitment and wheels position for all cars in the game
* Improved NEON lighting
* Improverd HEAD LIGHTS
* Improver car glass materials

POLICE CARS DLC released
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747490/OverDrift_Festival__Police_Cars_Pack/
This pack includes 5(!) POLICE cars with 2 unique liveries for each and technically upgraded to SPORT level!
Japanese and american police versions!
Special sound signal and active flashing lights!
2016 STRONGER P
1999 GODZ-34 P
1993 N240 P
2005 ARSENAL P
1990 5F SEDAN P

OTHER
* The initial spawn points for new players in the game are now located all over the world, and not just in the port, as was before
* The time for Tandem Battle has been increased; in some weather conditions the configs did not have time to pass
* Disabled camera shake in Livery Workshop
* Game сrash bug fixed
* Many small improvements and many bugs fixed

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39833847/f1f0a93548eaa0ab2d38f07963d1a0d8aaee61de.jpg[/img]
WEATHER AFFECTS PHYSICS
The car slips more on wet asphalt - reduction of friction force.
Friction is further reduced when the wheels get into deep puddles.
In winter at low temperatures friction is even lower.
The game features 4 seasons and 4 times of day - many different options for drift conditions.

ASPHALT SURFACE DETAILING
* Physical unevenness on the asphalt surface - wheels work off unevenness visually and physically
* New realistic asphalt material with new road markings
* Puddles with physical interaction
* Dirt
* Road patches

NEW TIRES
* New realistic tire material
* Tires get wet in wet weather and when driving through deep puddles
* 3 New tire sizes for all 120 rims
* 7 color tire compounds with colored smoke for OverPass owners
* 10 tread patterns for OverPass holders
* New Color Tire & Smoke menu
* Many rims have been improved

HALLOWEEN DECORATIONS
Added Halloween decorations in Fall Season: large pumpkins with music and destructible pumpkin blocks

CHAT
Ability to disable system messages in chat and chat sound

Many small improvements and many bugs fixed

notes.title: BIG UPDATE#14!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39833847/f73e133b0aae377df8da66ac401f0510e3d6d8ea.jpg[/img]

[h2]BAN SYSTEM[/h2]
Added a system for banning players who interfere with your goals. 
Vote to ban the player who is bothering you in menu Map>Persona.
When there are 4 votes against a player he will be kicked out of the server and will not be able to reconnect.
Ban system is still in testing mode and we are collecting feedback.

[h2]PERSONA MENU[/h2] (Main Menu > Map > Player)
You can nominate a player for Best Drift Style, Best Livery Design and Best Person nominations in the same menu - just vote.
You can also look at the player’s profile on Steam.
In this menu you can vote for ban this player.

[h2]GOOSIEST ISLAND[/h2]
New location added to the world of America

[h2]TATSUMI TANDEM BATTLE[/h2]
Short competitive config added to the world of Japan

[h2]NEW MUSIC[/h2]
Added 8 music tracks for the menu and game world in phonk style.
Music is now played during Tandem Battles, Drift Challenges and Freeride Events.

[h2]SOUND SYSTEM[/h2] 
Improved the sound system in the game: changed the attenuation with distance, added reverberation.
Now cars can be heard further and their sound is reflected in the distance.

[h2]NET CULL DISTANCE[/h2]
As an experiment the car loading distance has been increased.
This should lead to fewer friezes. Collecting feedback.

[h2]CHAT[/h2]
In-game chat has been improved.
Added colored system messages, nomination messages and ban messages.
Increased message length and expanded input line.

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
-Increased lifetime of smoke particles
-Improved widgets for Freestyle, Freeride Event and Drift Challenge modes
-TB reward now depends on the length of the config trajectory
-Fixed bug collisions of stone lamps and stones in Murakami Park
-Small improvements and many bugs fixed

notes.title: FULL RELEASE & HUGE UPDATE#8!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4-ueFyGbx0c
FULL RELEASE! 
Our project over the past 7 months since the release in early access has improved and grown significantly.
Now the game is being released in the full version and continues its development in a new status.
Active development of new updates continues! We have planned a lot of interesting ideas for implementation.

We are very grateful to the gamers community for participating in the development of the project!
Your comments and suggestions help us make the game better. Please continue to share with us your suggestions to improve the project.
Thank You!

- Happy New Year Update for Winter season: Christmas trees and music on locations, snowmans on the roads
- 2 new cars: 1969 STRONGER & 1990 M190
- Car Suspension visual and reworked physics
- Ackerman angle tuning in Tuning Menu > Wheel Angles
- Teleportation System in World Map Menu
- Car Interion Customization: different materials for cockpit
- Suspension Painting in Paint Menu
- New Particles Effects: Sparks, Derbis, Smoke and Exhaust
- Odometer added - mileage counter for each car
- Drop Cargo Functional - various effects on car collision depending on car mileage (Customization Menu > Cargo)
- No more PTS reset from hitting traffic cars
- Graphics improvements
- Many small improvements and many bugs fixed

Merry Christmas & Happy New Year!
